blocks.text: Hum jante hain ke liquid aur solid ka farq bilkul saaf hai, aur ek se doosre mein badalna (phase transition) hamesha ek fixed point par hota hai. Lekin kuch temperatures par bohat si cheezen aisi phase mein hoti hain jo na poori liquid hai na poori solid.

blocks.title: Liquid crystals
blocks.text: In cheezon ke molecules viscous (gaarhe) liquid ki tarah move kar sakte hain, magar solid ki tarah un ki motion restricted (mehdood) hoti hai. Aisi cheezon ko liquid crystals kehte hain.

blocks.text_alt: Crystalline solid → Cloudy liquid (liquid crystal) → Clear liquid

blocks.text: Zyada tar liquid crystals mein molecules sakht, rod (chhari) jaise hote hain, jin ki lambai un ke diameter (motai) se chaar se aath guna hoti hai. Ek saath bhare hon to molecules apne lambe axis taqreeban parallel (mutawazi) rakhte hain, jaise lakriyon ke dher mein lakriyan. Ek ek molecule fluid mein idhar udhar ja sakta hai aur apne lambe axis ke gird ghoom sakta hai, magar end over end (ulat palat) nahi ho sakta.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Garam karne par crystalline solid pehle dhundla (cloudy) liquid banta hai, yahi liquid crystal hai; aur garam karein to saaf (clear) liquid ban jata hai. Pencils ka dabba sochein: pencils khisak sakti hain aur apne gird ghoom sakti hain, magar sab ek hi rukh mein parallel rehti hain.

blocks.prompt: Liquid crystal liquid se kis tarah milta hai aur crystalline solid se kis tarah?
blocks.explanation: Liquid ki tarah us ke molecules harkat kar sakte hain aur woh behta hai. Crystal ki tarah us ke molecules ek order mein, lambe axis taqreeban parallel, rehte hain aur ulat palat nahi ho sakte, is liye un ki motion restricted hai.

items: Liquid crystals: solid aur liquid ke beech ki phase (crystalline solid → cloudy liquid crystal → clear liquid); rod jaise molecules (lambai diameter se 4 se 8 guna), taqreeban parallel; khisak aur apne axis par ghoom sakte hain, ulat palat nahi.
